proposal.description: An overcurrent window trip during soft start is treated as a hard fault and sends the FSM to S_OFF instead of into the S_HICCUP cool-down
proposal.reason: With enable high and no hard faults, a window_trip_SS pulse in S_SS now moves state_out to S_OFF with hiccup_active staying low. The FSM then restarts into S_SS on the next clock and never serves a cool-down.

proposal.description: In S_RUN either overcurrent window trip sends the FSM to S_HICCUP: the soft-start trip window_trip_SS is honoured outside S_SS
proposal.reason: In S_RUN with no hard faults, a window_trip_SS that stays high (for example a soft-start count held through the run) now moves the FSM to S_HICCUP. hiccup_active rises and en drops, when the FSM should stay in S_RUN.

proposal.description: Over-temperature in S_RUN is treated as a recoverable fault and sent through the S_HICCUP cool-down instead of straight to S_OFF
proposal.reason: When OTP rises in S_RUN with enable high, state_out goes to S_HICCUP and hiccup_active pulses high for a clock before the S_HICCUP hard-fault check moves it to S_OFF. It should go to S_OFF directly.

proposal.description: Reset puts the FSM in the S_HICCUP cool-down rather than S_OFF, as if power-up should wait a cool-down before the first start
proposal.reason: Right after reset, state_out reads S_HICCUP and hiccup_active is high instead of S_OFF. With enable high and no faults, the first start-up then waits for hiccup_done instead of entering S_SS on the next clock.

proposal.description: At the end of the cool-down S_HICCUP retries straight into S_RUN when the soft-start handshake SS_done is still high, skipping the re-ramp
proposal.reason: When hiccup_done arrives with SS_done high and no hard faults, the FSM goes to S_RUN and run_active rises instead of ss_active. This breaks the rule that a retry always re-ramps.

proposal.description: S_HICCUP retries when the overcurrent window trip has cleared instead of when the cool-down timer reports hiccup_done
proposal.reason: In S_HICCUP with window_trip low and hiccup_done not yet high, the FSM leaves for S_SS on the next clock and en rises without the cool-down having elapsed. With window_trip held high, it stays in S_HICCUP even after hiccup_done.

why: make lint already catches it: make lint: UNUSEDSIGNAL

proposal.description: The state register is clock-enabled by the converter enable, so it freezes instead of loading S_OFF when the enable is lost
proposal.reason: If en_SW or spi_enable drops in S_RUN, state_out and run_active stay at S_RUN instead of going to S_OFF. When the enable returns, the FSM resumes in S_RUN without a soft-start ramp.

proposal.description: The gate drive is re-enabled on the clock hiccup_done rises in S_HICCUP, a clock before the FSM has registered the retry into S_SS
proposal.reason: In S_HICCUP with enable high and no hard faults, en goes high as soon as hiccup_done rises while state_out still reads S_HICCUP. It should stay low until the FSM is in S_SS.

proposal.description: The gate drive is enabled in S_OFF as soon as the converter is enabled, a clock before the FSM has registered S_SS
proposal.reason: In S_OFF, when en_SW and spi_enable are high and no hard fault is present, en goes high on that clock while state_out still reads S_OFF and ss_active is low. The power stage then switches before soft start is active.

proposal.description: ss_active is also raised in S_HICCUP, as if the soft-start block had to be held active through the cool-down
proposal.reason: While the FSM is in S_HICCUP, ss_active is high together with hiccup_active, although it should be high only in S_SS.
